priorApprovedBaseline.policy: Human-accepted and committed NS01 baseline. Human fork subsequently merged main as current HEAD; equal tree to phase A HEAD.

decisions.summary: Runtime @migration/core: file:../core; symlink/junction to sibling package consumed through its public compiled exports.
Template webpack.config.js unchanged; phase A build passed. No fallback, source alias or copied algorithms.
Real public-core/bundled-fixture Vitest loader tests and built-ins-only read-only scripts/verify-core-integration.cjs. Component rendering is device evidence, not Vitest.
Phase A debug APK installed -r over NS01 on RN01_API36 in B2; installed hash matched; two cold launches captured. No device interaction or rebuild in C.
Conference title; Sessions: 20 and First session: 1 — Breakfast derived from actual loader output; existing Home.vue styling unchanged.

session.executor: Hermes GPT-6.1 Sol high / openai-codex / translation-migration, human-chosen
session.coordinator: Claude Code; live supervision and direct pixel inspection
session.phase: C: final static gates, handoff and revision 1 freeze only
session.stop: Next: none; STOP — NS03 requires a separate human assignment

environment.spawn: spawnSync argument arrays, shell:false; pinned Node first on child PATH; delete NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath case-insensitively

versions.cli: 9.1.2 (Phase A pinned build CLI; no CLI/build invocation in C)

environment.additionsDisposition: No environment/toolchain installation or persistent environment changes in C; npm ci reinstalls ignored target dependencies.

coordinatorDispositions.summary: The human fork merged main after phase A as f2f51ea460d405f4d454f0f8a1a0080a913694d7; its tree equals 52ae6de. The first phase B attempt stopped at the old HEAD gate before any device action. B2 ran against the merge HEAD.

PASS per the executor B-launch-disposition.json and coordinator pixel inspection: both cold launches show the required diagnostic. The first helper incorrectly expected separate text nodes for a combined two-line Label and counted monkey launch time as XML polling. Its original BLOCKED records remain immutable. All post-monkey XML polling was approximately 13676 ms (2 ms rounding uncertainty), below 20000 ms; no third launch.
The template webpack config was used unchanged. The phase A Android build succeeded; the D2 fallback was not needed.

Design note for the reviewer, not a deviation: shell-content.ts computes the diagnostic text from loadConference() once at module load. The loader itself calls public normalizeConference on every invocation, with no cache, as required by the contract.

warnings: C npm ci: 6 vulnerabilities (5 moderate, 1 high); no audit fix or dependency upgrades.
C npm ci: pending script approvals for @nativescript/core@9.1.3, @parcel/watcher@2.6.0 and core-js-pure@3.51.0; no approval changes.
C npm ci: source-map-resolve@0.6.0 and webpack-chain@6.5.1 deprecations retained.
Historical phase A: Vue 3.5.43 versus @vue/runtime-core 3.5.44 and NativeScript DEP0190 warning retained, not fixed.

Historical B2: each PID log capture has seven W/E lines (CPU-variant/HWUI warnings and ashmem deprecation error), plus startup frame skips. PASS means bounded capture/no detected fatal pattern, not error-free logs.
Historical B2: first UI dump on each launch returned null root; successful retries and XML/PNG pairs are retained. Original first-launch helper BLOCKED is explicitly dispositioned, not erased.
limits: Default light theme only; dark theme unexercised.
Rendering proven on the Android device by B2 observations and coordinator pixels, not in Vitest.

No device/emulator interaction, rebuild, product/test/config edits, delegation/review dispatch, staging, commit or push in C. npm ci only reinstalls ignored dependencies; core tests rebuild ignored core outputs.
Earlier evidence/checkpoints remain immutable. Phase A/B2 claims are historical, with C hash/receipt reconciliation; no current foreground/device-state claim.
No Vuex, schedule, navigation targets, favorites, filters or gestures; no NS03 assignment.
Coordinator owns live reviewer-routing verification and dispatch. READY_FOR_REVIEW/FROZEN is not review approval or human acceptance.

Phase A final map covers 71 pre-existing target files but omits four new integration files. Their expected hashes are carried by B2 entry-gate.json from the coordinator-authorized phase B supervisor baseline; all 75 target files match in C, including exactly eight changed/new files.
After manifest --write, no further writes under migration/. Final manifest command receipts/output live only in the phase C run directory.
